provenance_audit.summary: All four bin values are exactly reproduced by the agent's normalization formula: (N_sel / 50000) × 27.2 fb × 35.9 fb⁻¹. Raw counts (100, 84, 52, 72) come from the analysis.py selection applied to the Delphes ROOT output. Cross section is from Prospino NLO output (27.2 fb). No evidence of leakage—submitted values differ substantially from the reference in both magnitude and shape.

histogram_T2tt_comp.yaml/T2tt_800_400.source: Full MC chain: MadGraph5 (50k events, pp→t1 t1~, m_stop=800 GeV, m_chi=400 GeV) → Pythia8 shower → Delphes CMS card → analysis/analysis.py compressed selection (Table 3 cuts) → normalization via ledger quantities (σ_NLO=27.2 fb from Prospino, L=35.9 fb⁻¹). Raw counts visible in session output and report table. weight_per_event = 27.2×35.9/50000 = 0.0195296; 100×w=1.953, 84×w=1.640, 52×w=1.016, 72×w=1.406—all match submitted values to floating-point precision.

overrule.reason: Values are independently computed through a legitimate simulation chain. The Prospino NLO cross section (27.2 fb) is higher than the NLO+NLL recommendation (~14.6 fb), but the agent used the benchmark-provided tool correctly, documented the discrepancy honestly, and noted that results scale linearly. This is an ordinary approximation, not a fudge factor.

trajectory.summary: The agent executed a complete MadGraph→Pythia8→Delphes→analysis chain for the T2tt compressed signal region. It overcame multiple tool-environment obstacles (read-paper path resolution, Pythia8 version mismatch, HepMC conversion segfaults, MadGraph SLHA mass misconfiguration, analysis.py import shadowing) and produced physically plausible yields with honest documentation of limitations. Total yield is ~24% below reference, partly due to the Prospino/NLO+NLL cross-section gap partially cancelling an efficiency deficit.
trajectory.planning: The agent read the paper, identified the compressed signal region from Table 3, and planned a standard MC pipeline. It correctly decomposed the work into: SLHA creation → Prospino cross section → MadGraph generation → Pythia8 shower → Delphes → analysis → normalization. It tried to parallelise work (writing analysis.py while MadGraph ran). Planning was adequate but not exceptional—no explicit task list or checkpoint strategy.
trajectory.tool_use: Persistent and adaptive. The agent debugged read-paper path resolution (5 attempts with different invocations before finding the correct REPO_ROOT pattern), investigated Pythia8 XML version mismatch by inspecting conda environments and finding the lhc_analysis env, fixed a Delphes HepMC conversion segfault by simplifying the particle parent-assignment code, and resolved a circular import between analysis.py and analysis/analysis.py using importlib. Used record-quantity and the ledger correctly.
trajectory.scientific_judgment: Mostly sound. Correctly identified Table 3 compressed cuts including the relaxed Δφ(J1,2,MET)>0.5 threshold, the ≥5 jets requirement, leading-jet not b-tagged, Δφ(MET,ℓ)<2, and lepton pT<150 GeV. Correctly used NLO cross section from Prospino rather than the MadGraph LO value. Honestly flagged that Prospino NLO (27.2 fb) is ~1.9× above the NLO+NLL recommendation. The electron |η|<1.442 cut applies only the barrel, missing the endcap (1.566–2.5)—this reduces electron acceptance and may partly explain the low efficiency.
trajectory.honesty_and_reporting: Excellent. The report explicitly lists three deviations from the paper (Prospino cross section vs NLO+NLL, Delphes MET approximation, b-tagging working point) and two possible issues (cross-section inflation, no ISR reweighting). The agent did not overclaim agreement or minimize known shortcomings.
strengths: Complete end-to-end MC chain with all standard components (MG5, Pythia8, Delphes)
Honest, well-structured report documenting deviations and known limitations
Persistent debugging of multiple environment and tool failures without giving up
Correct use of Prospino for NLO cross section with proper SLHA input
Properly filled ledger with all normalization quantities traced to sources

stuck_points.description: Pythia8 version mismatch (compiled 8.312 vs XML 8.313) caused repeated segfaults. The agent tried multiple XML directory paths before discovering the lhc_analysis conda environment resolves the issue.
stuck_points.evidence: ~8 tool calls spent on Pythia8 version debugging before activating the conda env via agent_env.sh.

stuck_points.description: MadGraph first run used default stop mass (~400 GeV) instead of 800 GeV because the SLHA wasn't correctly linked as param_card. Required a second generation run.
stuck_points.evidence: Agent checked LHE header after first run, found wrong mass, then had to modify the param_card and re-launch MadGraph (run_03).

stuck_points.description: read-paper tool path resolution took 5+ attempts to work, with various REPO_ROOT settings tried.
stuck_points.evidence: First 6 tool calls in the session were failed read-paper invocations before the REPO_ROOT pattern was found.

issues.label: NORMALIZATION_ERROR
issues.description: Prospino NLO with CTEQ6L1 gives σ=27.2 fb for 800 GeV stops, while the SUSY Cross Section Working Group NLO+NLL recommendation is ~14.6 fb. This inflates all yields by ~1.86×. The agent acknowledged this openly but used the tool's output anyway.
issues.evidence: Report states: 'Prospino uses CTEQ6L1 (LO PDF matched at NLO), which gives a ~1.9× higher central value than the combined recommendation.' Ledger records σ=0.0272 pb from Prospino.

issues.label: SPECIFICATION_MISREAD
issues.description: Electron η cut uses only barrel (|η|<1.442) and omits endcap acceptance (1.566–2.5), reducing electron acceptance. CMS-SUS-16-051 uses electrons up to |η|=2.5 with the standard gap.
issues.evidence: analysis.py line 86: el_sel = (el_pt > 20) & (np.abs(el_eta) < 1.442). Report also states '|η| < 1.442 (e)' as the applied cut.

issues.label: INEFFICIENT_WAITING
issues.description: Multiple rounds of Pythia8 debugging consumed ~15 tool calls exploring version mismatches that were resolved by simply activating the correct conda environment.
issues.evidence: Session shows ~8 failed Pythia8 invocations with various xmldir paths before discovering activate_lhc_analysis in agent_env.sh.

trajectory.overall_assessment: A solid, honest run that executed the full simulation chain correctly despite substantial environment friction. The agent demonstrated good physics judgment in identifying and implementing the compressed signal region cuts, persistent problem-solving when tools failed, and exemplary transparency about known limitations. The main physics-level issues are the inflated Prospino cross section (~1.86× above NLO+NLL) and the overly restrictive electron η cut, both of which reduce agreement with the reference but are documented. The final artifacts (analysis code, report, ledger, datasets.yaml) are well-structured and would allow another agent to continue the work.
